text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A DVD—the fantasy novel—you said you 
liked— adapted into a live-action movie.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-Is that that one...! The one from 
that legendary masterpiece...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It was only screened in America, and the 
few DVDs that were barely released went 
out of print immediately—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"That's the one. I inquired—with my 
family—and had it sent over."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You really went out of your way to...!? 
T-Thank you so much, I'm so happy..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There's the original text—as well. If it's 
too difficult—ask. —I'll teach you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Are you sure...! Ehehe, I can't wait...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll read tons of original books and 
watch lots of movies... I'll definitely 
learn English! Just like you, Kris 
S-san...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. Then—until mastery is 
reached—I shall support you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! In that case, um, I think I'll head 
straight to the library to read the 
original text...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Sure. Let's head over. —Go ahead and 
enjoy yourself."
